decisions: Expose the exact stable Node/Edge catalog and exclude volatile updatedAt.
Use a documented CodeGraph implicit total order before LIMIT and caps.
Use Cypher three-valued logic with WHERE retaining only true.
Support doubled-backtick escaping and reject Unicode escape normalization in v1.

recommended_answers.Q1: Make SELECT/CTE-only SQL emission and a dedicated read-only SQLite connection an explicit requirement.
recommended_answers.Q2: Prove unsupported or mutating syntax is rejected before emitter/executor invocation and leaves real SQLite unchanged.
recommended_answers.Q3: Enforce the five-second deadline in an off-thread cancellable unit; clean or replace timed-out workers before reuse.
recommended_answers.Q4: Bound diagnostic excerpts to 160 UTF-16 code units with escaped controls and truncation-side metadata; oversized-input errors echo no query excerpt.
recommended_answers.Q5: Detect truncation with effectiveCap + 1 or equivalent bounded existence check; return no totalRows.
